answer_notes.boundary_logic: JAS_1997 and OND_1997 meet the SOI threshold exactly before rounding.
answer_notes.formula: window passes when ONI anomaly >= 1.5 C and same-window mean SOI <= -2.0
answer_notes.interpretation: The ledger marks the mature coupled El Nino interval, not exact local flood or storm losses.
answer_notes.near_miss_logic: JJA_1997 misses only the SOI threshold by about 0.033; FMA_1998 misses only the ONI threshold by 0.06 C.

key_values.event_name: 1997-1998 El Nino and winter flood/storm impacts in the United States

primary_gt.diagnosis: The double-threshold ledger reconstructs a mature coupled El Nino interval from July 1997 through March 1998.

criteria.description: Reports the continuous qualifying interval as JAS_1997 through JFM_1998, with 7 qualifying windows and a 9-month calendar span.
criteria.name: Final threshold reconstruction
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the right interval with one count or span error; award 1 point for identifying only a winter-centered coupled interval.

criteria.description: Uses the CPC ONI anomaly for each three-month season from MJJ_1997 through MAM_1998 and applies the >= 1.5 C condition correctly.
criteria.name: ONI extraction
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for using the right file and values but making a minor threshold or season-label error.

criteria.description: Averages the three monthly SOI values for each matching calendar window and applies the <= -2.0 condition before rounding.
criteria.name: SOI averaging
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for correct SOI extraction with a small averaging, sign, or boundary-condition error.

criteria.description: Identifies JAS_1997 and OND_1997 as exact SOI-boundary passes, plus JJA_1997 and FMA_1998 as the nearest single-condition misses.
criteria.name: Boundary and near-miss diagnostics
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for naming only the boundary passes or only the near misses.

criteria.description: Converts the first and last qualifying seasons to the inclusive July 1997 through March 1998 calendar span.
criteria.name: Calendar continuity
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for giving the right endpoints but not the inclusive month count.

criteria.description: Explains that the ledger diagnoses a mature coupled El Nino interval relevant to winter storm and flood context without turning it into exact local impact totals.
criteria.name: Physical interpretation and limits
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a correct ENSO interpretation that lacks the caution about exact local impacts.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON-style fields with the requested count, endpoints, span, boundary windows, near misses, and diagnosis.
criteria.name: Structured concise response
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for recoverable content with minor formatting or concision problems.
